subject: Cartella Labs renewal — hosted commit uplift, rate cap and QoS lanes
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@cartella.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Cartella Procurement <procurement@cartella.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal question — looking to increase monthly commit for hosted API

Hi Karthik,

Hope youre well. Were preparing our annual budget and would like to discuss pushing our hosted API monthly commit from 4M tokens to 9M tokens starting in July. Early indicators show a 2x traffic spike from a new personalization feature.

Primary asks:
- Can Redwood accommodate a mid-term uplift to 9M/month for the remainder of 2027?
- What changes would we see to the per-token rate bands and soft-throttle thresholds?
- Is there a quick path to reserve burst capacity for Black Friday spike windows?

I can pull procurement into the thread if you need to coordinate PO and legal. Wed like to understand cost delta and any lead times for provisioning.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Platform
Cartella Labs

[Attachment: traffic_snapshot_Q2-2027.csv]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@cartella.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Cartella Procurement <procurement@cartella.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal question — looking to increase monthly commit for hosted API

Maya, thanks for the heads up and the traffic snapshot — helpful context.

Short answers up front: yes, we can support an uplift to 9M tokens/month; there are two common paths depending on how you want to balance cost vs. latency guarantees:

1) Staged commit uplift (recommended)
   - Move to a 9M/month committed tier for hosted API (reduces unit cost).
   - Keep current soft-throttle bands but increase burst pocket to 200% of baseline for seasonal windows.
2) Add dedicated burst pocket + QoS lanes
   - Keep current commit at 4M, add a reserved burst pool and QoS routing so high-priority requests use dedicated capacity (higher per-token rate for burst).

Ive attached a proposed rate table that models both options against your current monthly consumption. Vanessa (cc) from provisioning will confirm lead time; typical provisioning for a committed uplift is 710 business days for hosted adjustment, shorter if you accept a burst-only add-on.

Next steps I propose:
- Ill schedule a 30-min call with ops to confirm provisioning windows and any temporary rollback plan.
- If procurement wants the formal quote and DocuSign, I can pull together the amendment and a one-page term summary.

Are you available Wed or Thu this week for a quick sync?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0124

[Attachment: proposed_rate_table.csv]

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal question — looking to increase monthly commit for hosted API

Looping in operational detail.

Karthik, Maya — provisioning note:
- For a committed tier increase to 9M/month well reserve the additional capacity in the region youre currently served from (us-west-2). Lead time: 5 business days after signature for most billing tiers; if Cartella needs the uplift to be effective by a strict date, tell us the target and well prioritize.
- Soft-throttle reconfiguration (raise thresholds and expand burst pocket) is low-risk and can be done during a normal maintenance window (we anticipate no downtime).
- QoS lanes require a short routing policy change and an updated service profile; ops can stage traffic split (canary at 5% then 25% then full) over 48 hours.

I attached a short term summary and an ops checklist for a July 1 start. Also included: a cost delta sketch (high/medium/low) for the three options Karthik outlined.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Provisioning & Ops, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Cartella_Renewal_Term_Summary.pdf]

Thanks Karthik/Vanessa. A few clarifications from procurement and engineering after reviewing the attachments:

- Procurement asks for a single amendment that:
  * increases the committed monthly tokens to 9M (prorated for the remainder of 2027),
  * includes a 90-day trial of expanded burst pocket at no extra charge while we verify the traffic profile,

- Engineering asks whether the burst pocket can be auto-scaled up to 250% on select dates (wed provide a calendar of expected spikes) and if theres any overage protection to avoid surprise bills.

If you can put a redlined amendment (Word/PDF) and a DocuSign-ready version, procurement can review and route for PO. Our target: have the amendment signed by 24 Jun to make the July 1 kickoff feasible.

Best,
Ethan Wu
VP, Engineering (Cartella Labs)
